components.title: Compute & custom silicon
components.role: GPUs, CPUs and custom accelerators execute workloads. Custom ASIC designers and hyperscalers define different pieces of the compute platform.
components.watch: Track actual shipments, system availability and measured work per watt.

components.title: Memory & storage silicon
components.role: HBM feeds accelerators; other DRAM holds data, NAND stores it, and controllers move it. Memory bandwidth and capacity can limit usable compute.
components.watch: Separate wafer capacity, memory output and storage-controller supply.

components.title: DSPs, SerDes & retimers
components.role: SerDes serialize and recover electrical data. DSPs process high-speed signals; retimers restore signal timing along links. These functions support copper and optical paths.
components.watch: Compare reach, error performance, power and deployment stage; link speed alone is incomplete.

components.title: Copper cables & connectors
components.role: Short electrical links connect boards, servers and racks. Active electrical cables add signal-conditioning electronics; connectors and cable assemblies complete the path.
components.watch: Track qualified cable designs and delivered systems, with reach and power in context.

components.title: Lasers & optical modules
components.role: Lasers supply light; modulators encode data and photodetectors receive it. Drivers and transimpedance amplifiers (TIAs) support transmit and receive signals. Transceiver modules assemble these functions into link endpoints.
components.watch: Distinguish a DSP, laser, optical engine and complete module; avoid counting them as interchangeable products.

components.title: Co-packaged optics & optical I/O
components.role: CPO brings optical engines close to switching or compute silicon in a shared package. External lasers and fiber attachment are separate parts of the system.
components.watch: Track sampling, qualification, production and deployments separately. Pluggable optics remain a distinct architecture.

components.title: Fiber, cable & physical connectivity
components.role: Fiber carries light between optical endpoints. Cable manufacturing, connectors and installation connect the semiconductor supply chain to physical infrastructure.
components.watch: Look for factory expansion, cable deliveries and installed connections; contracts are not completed revenue.

components.title: Switches, fabrics & transport
components.role: Switch silicon routes traffic; equipment and software coordinate the network. Coherent optical transport connects sites over longer distances.
components.watch: Separate scale-up, scale-out and scale-across systems, and match throughput to the actual workload.

components.title: Fabrication, packaging & system assembly
components.role: Foundries manufacture chips; packaging and precision assembly integrate them into usable components and systems. These capabilities are distinct from chip design.
components.watch: Follow fabrication, assembly, qualification and production output without double-counting customer and supplier sales.

components.title: Power equipment & skilled construction
components.role: Transformers, distribution equipment, electrical installation and cooling connect grid supply to operating racks. Skilled trades turn equipment into working facilities.
components.watch: Track equipment delivery, energized sites, local wages and operating jobs separately from investment plans.

milestones.title: Broadcom Bailly CPO
milestones.summary: Broadcom described its Tomahawk 5-Bailly CPO generation as in volume production while announcing a newer generation. That does not establish universal CPO adoption.

milestones.title: Lightmatter Passage
milestones.summary: Lightmatter reported Passage chiplet sampling and a throughput demonstration. Sampling is earlier than volume deployment.

milestones.title: Marvell / Celestial AI
milestones.summary: Marvell completed the acquisition of Celestial AI. Its optical scale-up technology now belongs within the Marvell profile; acquisition value is not product revenue.

milestones.title: Coherent optical engines
milestones.summary: Coherent announced OFC demonstrations of several CPO architectures and components. This is a demonstration announcement, not evidence of installed production capacity.

workforce_notes.title: What the August jobs report establishes
workforce_notes.summary: BLS reports gains of 22,000 construction jobs and 8,000 nonresidential specialty trade jobs, a subset of construction. BLS calls overall construction little changed. These broad industry figures do not isolate electricians or AI projects.

workforce_notes.title: The electrician outlook includes AI and the grid
workforce_notes.summary: BLS projects electrician employment to grow 9% over 2025–2035 and cites data centers, grid upgrades and renewable power connections among the drivers. Projected annual openings include replacement needs.

workforce_notes.title: Training capacity matters
workforce_notes.summary: IBEW’s May 2025 reporting describes rising data-center labor demand and a nearly tripled apprenticeship program at Baltimore Local 24. This is a dated local union account, not a national hiring statistic.

workforce_notes.title: Reading the White House article
workforce_notes.summary: The administration presents the August report as evidence for its reindustrialization agenda. The ledger uses the underlying BLS release for measured payroll changes; those figures alone do not establish policy or AI causation.

workforce_notes.title: Fiber supply also creates industrial work
workforce_notes.summary: Corning’s Meta agreement is for up to $6 billion over multiple years and supports a North Carolina expansion. Its employment language includes sustaining an existing workforce, not 5,000 newly created jobs.

energy_cases.name: First Solar · Iberia Parish, Louisiana
energy_cases.scope: Solar module manufacturing began in July 2025, according to the November inauguration release. The investment and current workforce are company-reported; factory capacity is not installed generating capacity.

energy_cases.name: Qcells · Georgia solar supply chain
energy_cases.scope: June 2026: Cartersville cell production started and module assembly was at full capacity. Full integrated production remained a Q3 target. The investment program and expected jobs span Georgia facilities.

energy_cases.name: Eaton · Jonesville, South Carolina
energy_cases.scope: The 2025 plan targets transformer production and hiring from 2027. Transformers support utilities, industry and data centers; the investment is enabling grid equipment, not renewable generation itself.

gaps: Company and product coverage is representative. A supplier list does not establish a contract between any two companies.
Comparable shipment volumes, yields, installed CPO ports and independently measured link energy still need research.
Five company profiles have no verified revenue record in this edition; this is a coverage gap, not zero sales.
Occupation projections, regional union reports and project hiring plans do not establish a national count of jobs caused by AI.
